notes: Hernia questions -> 21. GI bleeding -> organ of origin. Acute abdomen/perforation -> organ. Abdominal trauma organ injury (splenic rupture etc.) -> G1 Trauma unless it's about organ disease. Chest trauma -> G1. Head injury -> 36. Neck trauma -> 43. Maxillofacial trauma -> 42. Fractures -> ortho chapters. Urological trauma -> relevant urology chapter. Thyroid -> 27. Pancreatitis -> 15. Gallbladder/bile duct/jaundice -> 14. Liver abscess/hydatid -> 12. Portal hypertension -> 12. Mesenteric ischaemia -> 17. Volvulus/intussusception/obstruction -> 18. Hirschsprung/pyloric stenosis/paediatric GI -> G13 unless clearly one organ chapter (pyloric stenosis -> 11). Carpal tunnel / nerve palsy -> 8. Parotid -> 38. Thyroglossal/branchial cyst/cervical lymph nodes -> 40. Skin melanoma/BCC/SCC -> G6. Lip/tongue cancer -> 39.
